summary: Rebuilt the gizmo-registry extensions and verified in the browser that the Subagents inspector tab no longer throws the `each_key_duplicate` Svelte error. Confirmed the agent server hot-restarted from the registry edits, ran the app type check (0 errors), and recorded a memory note about registry extensions being live-edited from `~/.gizmo/registries`.
decisions: Record a memory entry stating that Gizmo extensions live in `~/.gizmo/registries` (a clone of gizmo-registry) and that editing them restarts the dev agent-server, so future sessions know where to look and warn the user when edits could interrupt running threads.
errors: Browser console initially showed `each_key_duplicate` Svelte runtime exception in the Subagents panel after the rebuild; resolved after a follow-up click on the Subagents tab.
